hotspots.label: Component A: Compound Microscope Optics
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: Structural ray path and lens system of compound microscopes and foldscopes used for resolving microscopic cells.

hotspots.tooltip_explanation: Classification of bacteria, microalgae, fungi, protozoa, and host-dependent viral replication cycles.

video_overview.topics_covered: Microscope Optics, Robert Hooke Cell Discovery, Antonie van Leeuwenhoek Single-Celled Organisms, Microorganism Classification

hotspots.tooltip_explanation: Transmission pathways of infectious pathogens via air, water, direct contact, and mosquito vectors (Anopheles/Aedes).

hotspots.label: Component B: Vaccine Memory & Immune Response
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: Mechanism of active immunization where weakened antigens stimulate white blood cells to synthesize protective antibodies.

video_overview.title: Health: Ultimate Treasure
video_overview.topics_covered: Holistic Well-being, Communicable vs Non-Communicable Diseases, Mosquito Vectors (Anopheles / Aedes), Vaccines & Immunity

hotspots.label: Component A: Current Magnetic Field & Oersted Effect
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: Deflection of magnetic compass needle near current-carrying wire demonstrating magnetic field creation.

hotspots.label: Component B: Soft-Iron Electromagnet & Heating Elements
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: Solenoid wire turns wrapped around soft-iron core and high-resistance nichrome heating transformation.

video_overview.title: Pillars of Electric Current
video_overview.topics_covered: Magnetic Effects of Current, Compass Needle Deflection, Soft-Iron Electromagnets, Heating Resistance (Nichrome Wire)

hotspots.label: Component A: Contact Forces & Friction Vector
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: Muscular push/pull forces and surface friction opposing relative motion measured in newtons (N).

hotspots.label: Component B: Non-Contact Electrostatic & Gravity Fields
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: Action-at-a-distance gravitational pull and charge induction causing electrostatic repulsion/attraction.

video_overview.title: Exploring Forces
video_overview.topics_covered: Pushes and Pulls, Contact vs Non-Contact Forces, Newtons (N), Effects of Force on Motion and Shape

image_asset.title: Hydrostatic Pressure Depth Gradient & Cyclone Pressure Low

hotspots.label: Component A: Surface Area Pressure & Hydrostatic Depth
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: Pressure formula P=F/A demonstrating high pressure on small contact areas and liquid pressure increasing with depth.

hotspots.label: Component B: Atmospheric Pressure & Cyclone Low System
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: High-speed wind creating atmospheric pressure drops and spiraling Coriolis wind systems forming tropical cyclones.

video_overview.title: The Physics of Pressure
video_overview.topics_covered: Pressure Formula (P=F/A), Hydrostatic Liquid Pressure with Depth, Atmospheric Pressure, Cyclone Formation & Wind Systems

image_asset.title: Interparticle Spacing in Solid, Liquid, and Gas States

hotspots.label: Component A: Rigid Solid Lattice & Liquid Flow
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: Solid state with strong interparticle attraction and liquid state with fluid particle mobility.

hotspots.label: Component B: Gas Spacing & Thermal Kinetic Expansion
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: Maximum interparticle spacing in gases and thermal energy breaking interparticle bonds during melting/boiling.

video_overview.title: Particulate Nature of Matter
video_overview.topics_covered: Particle Model of Solids, Liquids, Gases, Interparticle Spacing, Interparticle Forces, Thermal Kinetic Energy & Phase Changes

image_asset.title: Elements, Compounds, and Mixtures Classification Tree

hotspots.label: Component A: Pure Elements & Fixed Chemical Compounds
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: Single-atom elements and chemically bonded compound molecules combined in fixed stoichiometric ratios.

hotspots.label: Component B: Homogeneous/Heterogeneous Mixtures & Alloys
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: Physical combinations retaining individual properties, solid solution alloys, and magnetic/filtration separation.

video_overview.topics_covered: Pure Substances vs Mixtures, Elements and Chemical Compounds, Homogeneous & Heterogeneous Mixtures, Physical & Chemical Separation Methods

hotspots.label: Component A: Solute-Solvent Dissolution & Saturation
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: Homogeneous dispersion of solute particles in solvent and thermal expansion of saturation limits.

hotspots.label: Component B: Mass-Volume Density & Archimedes Buoyancy
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: Calculation of density d=m/V and buoyant force determine flotation versus sinking.

video_overview.topics_covered: Solutes, Solvents, and Solutions, Saturated Solutions & Temperature Effects, Density Calculations (d=m/V), Buoyancy & Flotation

image_asset.title: Laws of Reflection & Convex Lens Light Refraction

hotspots.label: Component A: Laws of Reflection & Spherical Mirrors
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: Angle of incidence equals angle of reflection (angle i = angle r) and image formation by concave/convex mirrors.

hotspots.label: Component B: Convex Lens Refraction & Solar Focal Point
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: Bending of light rays through transparent lenses and concentration of parallel rays at focal point.

video_overview.title: The Magic of Optics
video_overview.topics_covered: Laws of Reflection (angle i = angle r), Spherical Mirrors (Concave & Convex), Refraction through Lenses, Solar Concentrators

image_asset.title: Moon Phase Orbital Geometry & Gnomon Shadow Path

hotspots.label: Component A: Earth-Moon-Sun Orbit & Phases
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: Changing visible portion of sunlit lunar hemisphere during 29.5-day revolution around Earth.

hotspots.label: Component B: Gnomon Solar Shadow & Solar Noon Tracking
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: Vertical gnomon casting variable shadow lengths to measure solar time throughout the day.

video_overview.title: Keeping Time with the Skies
video_overview.topics_covered: Phases of the Moon, Sunlight Reflection on Non-Luminous Bodies, Earth-Moon Orbital Revolution, Gnomon Shadow Timekeeping

image_asset.title: Trophic Level Food Web & Abiotic-Biotic Cycling

hotspots.label: Component A: Biotic-Abiotic Ecosystem Interaction
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: Interdependence between living organisms (producers, consumers, decomposers) and non-living elements.

hotspots.label: Component B: Food Chains & Trophic Energy Flow
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: Sequential passage of solar energy through primary producers to top carnivores and nutrient recycling.

video_overview.topics_covered: Ecosystem Components (Biotic & Abiotic), Habitats, Populations, and Communities, Food Chains and Trophic Webs, Decomposer Nutrient Cycling
